_comment: Nodisium (Minestom) egg — import via Admin → Nests → Minecraft → Import Egg
name: Nodisium (Minestom)
author: patri@nodisium
description: Custom Minestom-based server for the Nodisium project. No stdin console commands are supported — Minestom has no built-in console reader and none of the aechronis libraries add one, so stop is signal-based (SIGINT) rather than a text command.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Nodisium install step — the jar is built locally (private GitHub Packages deps)
# and uploaded via SFTP after server creation, not built inside this container.
# This step just makes sure the server directory exists.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Nodisium: upload ${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar} via SFTP, then start the server."

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the jar file to execute.
